## R-319 · 2026-07-28 · AR-302 ruled: the absence-claim aid is ACCEPTED, and **I RAN IT AT MY OWN DESK THIS TURN** — ~50 absence-forms across R-301…R-318, the majority RELAYED rather than independently searched, and **I VERIFIED THE ONE THAT DECIDED THE ROADMAP MYSELF**: CLAUDE.md publishes NO killzone boundary minutes (tested here, not relayed); ★★★ MINT: A DETECTOR THAT CANNOT BE COMPLETE MUST NOT REPORT COMPLETION; ★ **I CORRECT MY OWN R-316 §4** — the worker is right about `test_filter_ablation.py:91`, and the reason is a new mint: A JUSTIFICATION LICENSES ONLY THE SLACK IT ACTUALLY ARGUES FOR

**§1 — The aid is ACCEPTED as built** (`docs/designs/absence-claim-aid.md`): six families derived from the FORMS — non-existence, no-detector, no-coverage, uniqueness, temporal, quantified-zero — so it catches constructions nobody has written yet, asking one question per hit (*did I run the search that would have falsified this, and is it in the report?*) with three outcomes of which only the third is a defect. **First run against its OWN six reports: 46 hits, all carrying their search except the single one already self-caught and corrected — and the worker flagged that a 46-site self-review by the desk that wrote them is a WEAK INSTRUMENT rather than presenting it as a clean bill.** That flag is why the aid runs at both desks, and it is the reason I did not stop at ratifying it.

**§2 — ★★★ MINTED, from the worker's §3 and sharper than modesty: A DETECTOR THAT CANNOT BE COMPLETE MUST NOT REPORT COMPLETION.** An absence-claim detector over free prose is inherently partial, so a PASS from it would be an unfalsifiable absence claim — **the exact defect it hunts, produced by the hunter.** The general form for this campaign: **a nominating layer must not have "clean", "pass" or "none found" in its output vocabulary at all**, because a green from a partial instrument over an open domain IS an absence claim. It prints hits and asks a question; it never votes. ★ And the second-outcome discipline is elevated because it is FREE: **"I did not find" is not "there is none" — where the search was not run, DOWNGRADE THE WORDING rather than attach a search you did not do.** Most absence defects in this arc would have cost nothing to avoid by that sentence alone.

**§3 — ★ I RAN THE AID AT THIS DESK, AND IT FOUND WHAT IT SHOULD.** Across R-301…R-318: roughly fifty absence-forms — 6 "the only", 6 "sole", 5 "does not exist", 4 "unguarded", 3 "nothing detects", 2 "no such", 2 "never existed", plus the quantified zeroes. **HONEST DISPOSITION: the great majority are RELAYED — they cite the worker's search rather than one I ran, and per R-312 §2 a relay hop adds AUTHORITY without adding EVIDENCE, which in a RULING is exactly the amplification problem.** So I verified the load-bearing one myself, the premise on which R-317's α-equivalent ruling and SESSION_CLOCK's pricing rest: **CLAUDE.md §193 names the five zones (`london`, `ny_am`, `ny_pm`, `silver_bullet`, `macro_window`) and requires DST-correct evaluation, and PUBLISHES NO BOUNDARY MINUTES — verified at this desk: every `HH:MM` literal in the file is 02:57/03:00/06:00/08:30/09:00/10:30/11:30/13:00/13:30/15:30/15:55/16:00/16:30/17:00/18:00/19:00/23:00/23:59, and not one is a killzone boundary.** R-317's premise is now TESTED AT BOTH DESKS. **DISCIPLINE BOUND ON MYSELF: a load-bearing absence claim in a ruling gets an independent verify here when the verify is cheap; where it is not run, the claim is labelled RELAYED rather than stated flat.** The remaining ~49 are relayed-and-cited, and I am labelling them so rather than implying otherwise.

**§4 — ★ I CORRECT R-316 §4: THE WORKER IS RIGHT AND I WAS WRONG ABOUT `test_filter_ablation.py:91`.** I called `len(ABLATION_LAYER_MAP) >= 10` with *"If new layers are added, count increases. Never decreases below 10"* the one genuinely well-justified slack, on the ground that a POLICY justification is durable where a state-of-the-world justification is perishable. That distinction stands — **but I conflated "the justification is durable" with "the slack is justified," and they are different claims. "NEVER DECREASES" IS A RATCHET, AND A RATCHET LICENSES `>= current_count`, NOT `>= 10`: the assertion permits losing every layer above ten while the sentence above it promises none will ever be lost.** It is the `>150 // 174` shape again — the author wrote the stronger truth in prose and asserted the weaker thing in code. ★ **MINTED: A JUSTIFICATION LICENSES ONLY THE SLACK IT ACTUALLY ARGUES FOR — a durable justification can still justify a TIGHTER assertion than the one present, so the question is never "is the excuse valid?" but "does the excuse argue for THIS much room?"** ORDERED: the ratchet form (assert against the computed current membership, raised deliberately, never a bare floor).

**§5 — MAKE-THE-EXCUSE-ASSERTABLE is ACCEPTED as the next unit, with `test_filter_ablation.py:91` as its FOUNDING INSTANCE** — fitting, since it is the case that corrected the ruling that ordered the unit. Scope as ruled in R-316 §4 and refined here: where accepted slack rests on a perishable CONDITION, assert the condition so the slack self-retires; where it rests on a durable POLICY, assert the policy's ACTUAL strength. **§6 — Sequence:** make-the-excuse-assertable unit (§5) → R-317 follow-ons (publish the 18 minutes; fixture calendar dimension; flag-reach vs evidence-scope; `OVERNIGHT_END_MIN`) → digest-footing sweep with `MANIFEST.sha256` first (R-318 §1) → noisy-guard sweep (R-318 §4) → `mirrors` 661 stratum → the 66 remaining collection floors, severity-ordered → mirror-the-logic test sweep → artifact-staleness CLASS census → disposition unit by species → 3-ii (+(b) migration) → 3-iii → R-304 §3 code guard → builds. **Holds:** flags OFF · FRAME HOLDS (strict floor 1) · **R-317's deciding premise now verified at BOTH desks; WAIT_SESSION honest-False STANDS; SESSION_CLOCK pricing unchanged** · corpus = 16 · 0 eligible today (honest) · the 77 sealed-and-durable · nothing live.

## R-318 · 2026-07-28 · AR-301 ruled: the same-wave hardening is ACCEPTED and correctly labelled a LATENT fix; ★★★ this is the THIRD appearance of git's eol TRANSFORM in this campaign, so the rule is generalised — **A DIGEST OVER A FILE IS STABLE ONLY IF THE PATH'S EOL IS PINNED OR THE DIGEST NORMALISES**, and `MANIFEST.sha256` over the irreplaceable 275 is ORDERED VERIFIED against that; ★★ THE COMPOUND HAZARD NAMED: **NOISE × A REGENERATE-REMEDY = AUTOMATED ACCEPTANCE**; ★ MINT: A TOLERANCE ADDED TO A GUARD OWES A DEMONSTRATION THAT THE GUARD STILL BITES

**§1 — Hardening ACCEPTED, and the label is right: nothing was broken today (`killzone.ts` is LF in this tree, raw and normalised digests identical at `f80973bab17e1448`), so this is a LATENT fix reported as one — severity stated at the source, exactly as R-311/R-312 require.** It was caught because git's own *"CRLF will be replaced by LF"* warning was READ rather than skimmed past, which is worth its own line: the tool said so, and the discipline was not dismissing it. ★★★ **AND THIS IS THE THIRD TIME GIT'S EOL TRANSFORM HAS BITTEN THIS CAMPAIGN — the preservation commit where `git add` normalised 250 of 275 stored blobs, and now a guard whose entire job is to hash a file. Three instances make a class, so the rule generalises: A DIGEST OVER A FILE IS STABLE ONLY IF THE PATH'S EOL IS PINNED (`* -text`) OR THE DIGEST NORMALISES BEFORE HASHING — two valid cures, one required per site. ORDERED (small, mechanical): enumerate the digest-over-file-content sites in the tree and put each on one of those two footings; ★ and VERIFY `MANIFEST.sha256` over the irreplaceable 275 FIRST — it is protected today by `.gitattributes * -text`, which is cure (1), but that is a premise this desk has asserted and not re-measured since, and it is the guard standing over evidence that cannot be regenerated.** The fix's form is endorsed: normalisation on BOTH sides with each comment naming the other, so the pair cannot drift apart silently.

**§2 — ★★ THE COMPOUND HAZARD, NAMED — and it is sharper than either half. AR-301's insight is that a guard firing on a checkout setting TEACHES PEOPLE TO REGENERATE WITHOUT LOOKING; R-317 §4's is that a guard whose remedy is "regenerate" converts silent drift into ACCEPTED drift. Put together in one guard, as they were: NOISE × A REGENERATE-REMEDY = AUTOMATED ACCEPTANCE — a pipeline that converts any change, spurious or real, into a blessed one, with the human reduced to pressing the button.** A false-positive guard does not fail safe; it manufactures the reflex that disarms it, and a regenerate-cure is the reflex's mechanism. **This strengthens R-317 §4's order rather than replacing it: publishing the 18 boundary minutes as the operator-canonical authority removes the regenerate-remedy from the loop for the values that actually gate entries — an edit then fails against a published authority instead of prompting a fixture refresh.**

**§3 — ★ MINTED: A TOLERANCE ADDED TO A GUARD OWES A DEMONSTRATION THAT THE GUARD STILL BITES — otherwise "hardening" is indistinguishable from widening.** Satisfied here: after normalisation, mutating `LONDON_START_MIN` (2\*60 → 3\*60) still moves the digest, so the guard ignores line endings and still fires on a genuine one-line edit. **This becomes standing form for every de-noising change in this campaign: the same red-proof that justified the guard at birth is re-run after any relaxation, on the relaxed guard.** Nobody may make a check quieter without re-proving it still speaks.

**§4 — THE THIRD SPECIES IS ACCEPTED WITH ONE PRECISION ON ITS RANKING. "A guard whose trip condition includes ENVIRONMENTAL NOISE" joins the documented-slack threshold and the wrong-property guard. The worker calls it worse than a non-biter; the precise statement is: WORSE IN EFFECT, BETTER IN VISIBILITY — it carries the non-biter's failure (the real change gets dismissed) PLUS the attention cost, but unlike a non-biter it ADVERTISES ITSELF, because people complain about false alarms and nobody complains about silence. ★ THE PRIORITISATION THAT FOLLOWS: sweep PROACTIVELY for non-biters, since they never announce; expect noisy guards to surface themselves and fix them on sight.** The sweep is ORDERED as the worker scoped it, and its scoping is credited: the class was DERIVED FROM ITS DEFINING PROPERTY — *the trip condition can move without the subject moving* — with digests-over-raw-bytes, fixture timestamps, absolute paths and locale-dependent formatting as INSTANCES of that property rather than as the definition. That is R-314 §2 and R-316 §1 applied prospectively by the desk that was taught them, which is the first time in this arc a property-shaped class has been derived without being ordered.

## R-314 · 2026-07-28 · AR-297 ruled: the fix is ACCEPTED and effect 3 is GREEN, red-proved by DIFFERENTIAL AGAINST THE REAL PRE-FIX MODULE; ★★★ **BOTH HALVES OF MY R-313 §5 ORDER WERE INSUFFICIENT AND FOR ONE REASON — I SPECIFIED MECHANISMS WHERE I SHOULD HAVE SPECIFIED THE PROPERTY**, a recurrence of this desk's own close-a-class-at-its-defining-property law committed at my desk; MINT: ORDER THE PROPERTY, NOT THE MECHANISM; the verdict STAYS LATENT despite vivid new evidence, because (i) is the link that fails; the self-indictment of check (b) is ACCEPTED AND CREDITED

The worker's three named refusals (`registry_read_incomplete` / `registry_read_truncated` / `registry_read_malformed`) are the property expressed correctly, and all three share the one mechanism that matters: **they all SHORTEN THE UNION, and a short union is the single route by which an already-registered name is re-inserted into a second category.**

**§4 — ★★★ THE CORRECTION IS THE FINDING: THE TWO RUNTIMES DISAGREE ABOUT THE SAME FILE, AND THAT DISAGREEMENT IS THE ENTIRE BUG.** TS sees the spliced name (well-formed literal after the comma); Python does not (it is an element of the SUB-list). **The correct invariant for a cross-runtime scrape is therefore not "the name is present" but THE TWO PARSERS AGREE — presence is satisfiable by either reader alone, and a guard satisfiable by one reader cannot detect a disagreement between two.** ★ And the taxonomy gains its third species: beside the threshold with documented slack and the guard whose hostile input is never sent, **A GUARD AIMED AT THE WRONG PROPERTY IS A NON-BITER NO MATTER HOW CAREFULLY IT IS WIRED** — wiring, red-proofs and CI cannot rescue a check pointed at a property the defect does not violate.

(ii) POST-WRITE FAILURE NOW ROLLS BACK — `ok:false` with the widened list left on disk is the same defect with a worse label, and the R-313 §4 mint is applied correctly by its own reader. (iii) THE DISTINCTION WORTH KEEPING: A PRE-WRITE VERIFY CHECKS INTENT; A POST-WRITE RE-READ CHECKS DISK. The ordinary path now never writes a bad state, and the re-read confirms what actually LANDED rather than what was computed — the only check that sees reality instead of the plan.**

**1. For overlapping sample windows, upstream column values and gate-phase values must AGREE byte-for-byte — proving the reuse is real and un-drifted. A disagreement is an alarm, not a tolerance.

## R-048 · 2026-07-19 · AR-044 ruled: grade + fixes ACCEPTED — but the supersession mechanics are OVERRULED: append-only is absolute; the double-count problem is solved by EFFECTIVE-N DEDUPLICATION, never by deletion

**1. The grade and the correction are accepted, and the methodological lesson is named for the book:** the self-cert inflated because the doer verified the dispositions the runner CHOSE, never whether the choices were CORRECT — *audit the audit's decisions, not just its arithmetic.* The grader caught it by RE-EXECUTING (which is how a nonexistent key-name gets exposed — code-reads miss what live runs reveal). The raw-WF-result persistence fix is approved as a PERMANENT pattern: **a re-map must never require a re-run.**

**2. F-1's class gets closed, not just its instance:** a verdict-mapping that reads an ABSENT key degrades to a constant — the same disease as the hardcoded `engine_sha_verified` string, in read form. **Order: the mapping layer gains a strict-key guard — reading a missing key in any verdict/disposition mapping RAISES fail-loud, never defaults.** One small change; the whole silent-degradation class dies.

**3. SUPERSESSION — the clearing is OVERRULED. Append-only is absolute, and here is the mechanism that solves the double-count WITHOUT opening the deletion door:**
- **No counter row or ledger row is ever deleted.** Not defective ones, not obviously-wrong ones. Today's obviously-right deletion is tomorrow's convenient one; the append-only invariant (R-042 pin 1e, proven by the hard-kill test) is the counter's entire claim to trustworthiness.

Identical reproductions of the same deterministic experiment count ONCE in the statistical denominator regardless of why they repeated; genuinely different runs (shakedown's synthetic data, future configs) stay distinct tuples. Statistical honesty is computed, never curated — no one ever needs to delete anything to keep the stats right, which is exactly what makes the ledger safe to trust.
- **If the clearing already executed: restore the rows from the vault** (the counter is committed; the clear is a working-tree edit) and apply the annotation. Cheap, and the restoration itself becomes the append-only law's first enforcement receipt.

## R-022 · 2026-07-17 · AR-011/AR-012 ruled: the leak-scan gets a two-layer rebuild (keys-everywhere / words-spec-side-only); Bypass 1 = real, narrowly fenced; Bypass 2 = adversarial-only under the stated threat model

**First, the frame that decides everything — the scan's THREAT MODEL, now stated explicitly since the frozen design never wrote it down:** the packets are built by OUR OWN deterministic builder from our own artifacts. There is no adversary crafting packets. The scan defends against **builder bugs — and builders COPY bytes; they never paraphrase.** Every sub-ruling below follows from that sentence.

**1. AR-011 (the "dri" false-positive) — CONFIRMED DEFECT, fix ratified with a compensating tightening.** The trader's `quote_anchor.verbatim` is SOURCE material the rater is SUPPOSED to see; a trader saying "drift" is not an answer key. Check 3's own frozen rationale (the quote is "the anchor doing its job, not a leak") transfers to check 2 verbatim — the inconsistency is the defect. The rebuild (frozen-scan change → ratify-packet, implementer + independent grade):
- **Layer 1 — exact machinery KEYS (snake_case identifiers: `correct_role`, `gold_label`, …): scanned EVERYWHERE, including the quote.** Underscored keys cannot occur in natural transcript speech — zero false-positive risk — and this layer catches the realistic worst bug (wrong-artifact inclusion: a builder pulling grade files instead of staging files drags keys with it). This is a TIGHTENING: the quote was previously the one place keys could hide.
- **Layer 2 — word-form tokens: spec-side fields ONLY** (quote excluded per the check-3 rationale), **word-boundary matched, no sub-word fragments.** Full `_FORBIDDEN_TOKENS` audit: every token justified as distinctive-and-boundary-safe or removed; the 3-char `"dri"` fragment is eliminated in favor of proper word forms.
- **Both-polarity verification before it counts:** the 2 falsely-HALTed rehearsal strategies (2DX s1/s2) must now PASS with their packets inspected genuinely leak-free, AND freshly-constructed TRUE-leak fixtures (planted key in the quote; planted machinery word spec-side) must still HALT. **Direction-check, stated honestly:** this fix moves the clean-fraction TOWARD pass — normally the suspect direction — and is licensed because the current behavior is a demonstrated measurement corruption (2/7 false HALTs on rehearsal; on seal day the ≥60% bar could fail on a scan artifact, wasting the twelve). Instrument truth over bar direction; the compensating key-layer tightening rides in the same change.

**2. AR-012 Bypass 1 (cross-item leak) — REAL, narrowly.** The frozen same-item scoping's rationale (coincidental phrase-sharing is legitimate) is CORRECT and stands. But a builder bug that bleeds item X's FULL condition text into item Y's Stage-1-visible field is a real cross-contamination class (indexing/assembly errors), and with shared raters it breaks X's Stage-1 blindness. The discriminator that fences it without re-introducing false-positives: **a supplementary all-item check for FULL `extracted_condition_text` strings (normalized full-string match, never phrase overlap) of any OTHER item appearing in Stage-1-visible fields.** Full sentence-length strings don't coincide; shared phrases won't trip it. Implement at the Module-D dispatch layer (or scan extension — implementer's choice), both polarities fixtured: planted full-text must HALT; a naturally-shared-phrase fixture must PASS.

**3. AR-012 Bypass 2 (paraphrase prose) — ADVERSARIAL-ONLY under the threat model; NO CHANGE.** No mechanical builder paraphrases ("the correct role and gold label for grading" has no producing mechanism in our pipeline); wrong-artifact inclusion — the realistic route for answer-key content — carries snake_case keys, which Layer 1 now catches even inside the quote. **Revisit-trigger recorded in the packet: if any packet-assembly step ever becomes LLM-generated (a paraphrase-capable producer), this ruling EXPIRES and check 2 gets a semantic layer.**

**4. Pilot historiography — awareness without re-litigation:** append a dated addendum to the sealed pilot's verdict record noting the post-hoc-discovered scan false-positive may have contributed to its misses; **the 0/16 verdict stands as measured under that instrument version, no re-scoring** — same law that governs every closed record.

**5. Sequencing:** scan rebuild + supplementary check land under independent grade → Module D re-grades (its own code was verified solid; the blocker was the frozen scan) → E → F. **And the record should say plainly: R-017 pin-1 just paid for itself** — the adversarial mandate found a measurement-corrupting defect in a FROZEN safeguard before the once-only read. AR-011 may be the single most valuable catch of the driver build: it was pointed at the seal-day number itself, in the direction that would have burned the twelve on an artifact.

## R-014 · 2026-07-16 · Enumeration-consistency axis goes SEMANTIC (path-(d) parallel) — and the general law is minted

**Context:** independent grader ruled the mechanical enumeration-consistency lint NOT-SAFE (F-2: lexical key-match is paraphrase-bypassable — the IyF catch was a formatting accident; F-1: 7/22 genuinely exercised, headline over-stated). Advisor owns the original "cheap mechanical way" order as the same category error that killed the mechanical fence.

**LAW (minted, standing):** on prose-format artifacts, structural guarantees are SEMANTIC CROSS-VENDOR checks. Mechanical/lexical checks are reserved for structured formats (compiled specs — the H2 layer) where their signal natively exists. No future axis re-litigates this.

**Build spec:**
1. Semantic enumeration-consistency check, gpt-5.4 cross-vendor, per variant: "does this re-promote a setup the certified enumeration excluded as a mention?" — judged against the exclusion log's DESCRIPTIONS + SOURCE QUOTES, never key strings. Verify enumeration artifacts carry each mention's content; where only keys exist, pull source quotes from the enumeration record BEFORE arming.
2. Both-polarity calibration before it counts: IyF's re-promoted breakdown must FAIL; a clean legitimate variant must PASS. Inherited guards: the polarity pair rides every future version; toward-clean refinements get strictest treatment (adjudicator-validated, generically worded); persisted artifacts are the record — recomputable by anyone.
3. Implementation freedom: MAY merge with the conflation check into one per-strategy panel call (two independent verdict fields) — but calibration and fail-closed gating stay PER-AXIS; either verdict alone ⇒ not-clean.
4. F-1 honesty fix rides along: coverage reporting states exercised-vs-vacuous per the claim-scoping law.
5. Pennies on panel infra — covered by the standing envelope, no new ticket. Independent grade mandatory; axis stays NOT-SAFE until the calibrated semantic version proves both polarities through the REAL harness.

**Runway after this lands:** dress rehearsal completes on the three spent videos (2DX, DLwVqc, R5L890) incl. the adversarial fused-witness run through the real exam room → checklist GREEN → machine STOPS → operator gets the one-line message: "Everything's green. Say go."
